rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user before acting, and it executed an order-changing write (cancelling the entire order) without first confirming with the user. Although it referenced the user’s email and an order ID, there was no explicit verification that the order belonged to the authenticated user. Additionally, the user asked to cancel specific items if possible, but the agent went straight to full cancellation without confirming that step. These actions violate the stated policy requirements to authenticate and to confirm before any write.
